name: NJ’s Accounting and Tax Services
description: Small-business bookkeeping and tax services founded by Njock Simon. Flat monthly pricing from $299, a real accountant reachable by email with a four-business-hour reply, and a guarantee that your books are current within 30 days or your next month is free.
disambiguation: The “NJ” in this business name refers to the founder, Njock Simon — not the US state of New Jersey. The firm is remote-first and serves small businesses across the United States.
